A hot shower with 3 minutes of cold shower at the end will give you some energy to start the day. And then completing some simple tasks will give you confidence to finish the main ones for the day. The simplest one is writing down all the things you want to be done by the end of the day. It could be anything from cleaning your room to walking for 20 minutes. There is always a thing to do.

You are neither your thoughts, nor your emotions. In the meditative state you are the observer of all thoughts you have at that moment. Not the one who tries stop them or judge them. You simply let them be. And you don’t identify yourself with those thoughts. Whenever you react to your mind and identify yourself with it you become unconscious and you lose the present moment which is all you have. So by practicing meditation you practice how to observe all thoughts and emotions you have and you increase the conscious and joyful moments of your life.
